svg.title: Trace RAG symptoms to diagnostic checkpoints

svg.aria-label: High recall, low faithfulness. Inspect the generator, then the judge. The pipeline runs from the question through Qdrant, retrieved passages, and the generator to the answer. Labels and the judge are evaluation checkpoints; reference answers check correctness. Numbered components show the inspection order.

svg.text: 1 Inspect the generator. 2 Read the judge verdicts.
Low recall + low faithfulness: inspect retrieval, then generation.
Low recall + high faithfulness: check the labels, then retrieval.
High recall + high faithfulness: check ranking, relevancy, then correctness.
Highlighted checkpoints suggest an investigation, not a proven cause.
